edges: Miss Phoebe Throssel and Valentine Brown have a developing romantic relationship that is complicated by Brown's departure to fight in Europe.
Captain Brown returns after ten years and rekindles his feelings for Miss Phoebe.
Miss Phoebe Throssel creates a fictional character named Miss Livvy to express a more flirtatious side of herself.
Captain Brown realizes that he loves Miss Phoebe Throssel and not her fictional character Miss Livvy.
Captain Brown asks for Miss Phoebe's hand in marriage but is turned down without explanation.
